protocol.first_batch: 7 variants x 64 environments, one designated first episode per slot
protocol.isolation_batch: 3 single-perturbation overrides x 1000 environments, one designated first episode per slot
protocol.physical_contacts: Control-step contacts latched across each episode; not every physics substep.
protocol.source_success: Within 0.1m at least once without monitored collision/failure during whole episode. Does not require staying at goal.
protocol.comparator: Earlier 1000-episode wall_15800 baseline is historical, same checkpoint/seed/core production code, not a fresh paired causal run. Different options can change random draw consumption.
protocol.overrides: Single-factor diagnostic flags apply after strict checkpoint validation without rebuilding the initial cached observation; RFI/PD controller overrides target first episodes only. The separate CLI --no-perturbations path rebuilds initial observations without noise.

evaluation.sampling: Fixed per-slot quotas; all designated episodes complete; later resets excluded

metric_definitions.success: Reached within 0.1 m at least once, with no observed obstacle or monitored self contact or source collision during the episode, and no fall/invalid termination. Uses the source 20 s horizon.
metric_definitions.physical_collision: Any observed obstacle contact during the episode.
metric_definitions.stop_command: Source command vector norm below 0.2; not actual speed.

findings.finding: Every episode in both hurdle variants contacts the low bar while all 11 query SDF values remain positive at first contact. First contacts include foot geometry in 62/64 baseline and 64/64 quiet episodes; the other two baseline first contacts involve the shin. All terminate by low head height, none by inverted up axis.
findings.implication: Body query points do not certify the full collision envelope. More informative sensing alone has not been shown to fix the learned crossing behavior.

findings.finding: All-perturbations-off wall runs settle, but only after overshooting. Source one-way gait latch prevents returning to goal. The detailed 8-slot trace and 64-slot event analysis is linked below.
findings.implication: Near-field extent and stopping transitions must use measured velocity and calibrated braking/latency; changing far representation cannot by itself repair low-level overshoot.

findings.finding: Separately disabling RFI, observation noise, or random PD leaves zero settled-step fraction across each 1000-episode cohort. No single-factor cause is established.
findings.implication: Aggregate quiet improvement does not justify attributing instability to one perturbation or changing production randomization.

findings.finding: Actor stop-command coherence did not improve settling; naive rearming produced 47/64 fall terminations.
findings.implication: Neither inference-only intervention is an accepted fix; production behavior stays unchanged.

verification.full_repository_tests: Not passing on this CPU-only local machine: existing test_scan.py initializes CUDA during collection, test_adapter.py requires CUDA. No full-suite success claim.
verification.post_run_diagnostic_hardening: After these experiments, a finite-placeholder field query plus diagnostic_field_valid flag and two NaN/Inf tests were added. All recorded episodes had invalid=false; existing data remain attributed to their original 26f42f9/6e6a153 commits.
